# Natural Spices UAE

> Premium spices, herbs, nuts, and grocery products delivered across the UAE.

## About
Natural Spices UAE is an online grocery store specializing in high-quality spices, herbs, dried fruits, nuts, oils, and everyday grocery essentials. Based in Dubai, UAE, we deliver nationwide with same-day delivery available in select areas.

## Website
- URL: https://naturalspicesuae.com
- Dashboard: https://dashboard.naturalspicesuae.com

## Products
We offer a wide range of products including:
- Whole and ground spices (turmeric, cumin, coriander, black pepper, cardamom, saffron, etc.)
- Herbs and seasonings
- Dried fruits and nuts
- Cooking oils and ghee
- Rice, flour, and grains
- Pickles and chutneys
- Ready-made spice mixes
- Health and wellness products
